questions.prompt: Why must the base pack load before the domain packs?
options: Handlers run in load order, and the first blocking tool_call handler ends the chain, so base gates run first
pi refuses to start without a base pack in front
Domain packs cannot register tools unless the base loaded first
Entries appended by the base are sent to the model only if it loads first
questions.explanation: Handlers run in load order. When the base loads first, its gates run before any domain gate, and a block ends the chain.

questions.prompt: The run log uses pi.appendEntry. Where does the data go?
options: Into the system prompt as a new section
Into the session file, without being sent to the model
questions.explanation: appendEntry stores data in the session without sending it to the model, so a log costs no tokens.

questions.prompt: You change the house rules text in packs/base/extension.ts. What happens to the SQL, Kubernetes and quant experts?
options: Nothing, until each pack copies the new text
All three get the new rule, because each loads the base
Only the expert you run first
They all fail, because the base changed
questions.explanation: Every expert loads the base pack, so one fix reaches all of them. That is the reason for a shared base.
